pages.text: $(l)Power Scaling$()$(li)Use steam turbines instead of direct reactor output; a single turbine produces ~430k RF/t and is the recommended Chapter 2 power source.

$(li)Reactor size and turbine size are independent—you can scale the reactor larger than the turbine if needed.$(li)For cyanite production (required for turbines and later tech), fill the reactor with yellorium seeds once available.

$(l)Turbine Setup$()$(li)Use Ludicrite coils for optimal output (~435k RF/t at 2000 mB/t steam); Enderium is second-best.$(li)Ensure water input meets demand: low output (e.g., ~200 mB/t) usually means insufficient water flow.
$(li)Build turbines around the shaft and blades first (as JEI shows), then add the controller and coils.

$(l)Fluid & Energy Transfer$()$(li)Fluid Laser Relays (Actually Additions) are reliable for steam/water transfer; space lasers 4–5 blocks apart.$(li)Infinite water blocks auto-output to all sides—use them in a wall layout for steady supply.
$(li)Draconic Evolution Wireless Energy Crystals (first two tiers) are the best wireless option in Chapter 2—avoid Ender energy transfer.
